messages.subject: Project Drake — negotiation strategy before v3
messages.plaintextBody:
Sarah,

Before I send the buyer's response draft, my recommendation on the open points: settle the cap at 27.5% (£6.16m) — splits the difference and Charles indicated he'd accept anything up to 30%; hold general claims at 21 months; concede de minimis at £30k; and push the escrow from 18 to 24 months given the live Phase II environmental work. That protects us on the contamination risk without reopening the indemnity cap. Agree?

James

Sarah
